rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday choice when “specific” contrasts with vague or general, especially for details or requirements.

example.english: The requirements for this job need to be very specific; don't just say “as soon as possible.”
example.traditional: 呢份工作要求講得好具體，唔好淨係話「盡快」。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 jiu1 kau4 gong2 dak1 hou2 geoi6 tai2 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 waa6 zeon6 faai3

rows.note: Choose this when “specific” means explicit, definite, or clearly stated rather than merely detailed.

example.english: You need to be more specific so I know which one you want.
example.traditional: 你要講得明確啲，我先知你想要邊樣。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 gong2 dak1 ming4 kok3 di1 ngo5 sin1 zi1 nei5 soeng2 jiu3 bin1 joeng6

rows.note: Use this when something is for or applies to a designated particular person, thing, group, or situation.

example.english: This offer is only for specific members.
example.traditional: 呢個優惠只適用於特定會員。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau1 wai6 zi2 sik1 jung6 jyu1 dak6 ding6 wui2 jyun4

rows.note: Use this mainly in medical or technical contexts for a test or symptom that identifies one condition rather than another.

example.english: This antibody is specific to this virus.
example.traditional: 呢隻抗體對呢種病毒有特異性。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 kong3 tai2 deoi3 ni1 zung2 beng6 duk6 jau5 dak6 ji6 sing3
